question: Does the activation-timing effect recur under a recurrent learned sequential recommender when data, tasks, conditions, seeds, candidate masks, and analysis are held fixed?

validityGates.learnedModel: each family must beat global popularity in test NDCG@10 in every category
validityGates.orderSensitive: each family must change Top-10 under reversed history in at least 0.50 of evaluated cases in every category
validityGates.primaryRecurrence: fixed-trace T1 lower 95% hierarchical-bootstrap bound must exceed 0.15 for each family
validityGates.resolvedEquivalence: T2 and T3 upper 95% bounds must be below 0.05 for each family
validityGates.inertLogging: no-memory and logged-inert must match within each family

uncertainty.resampling: tasks and model seeds within category; categories equally weighted

claimBoundary: GRU4Rec denotes the recurrent encoder family. The implementation uses the same sampled next-item loss as SASRec to isolate encoder architecture; it is not a reproduction of every optimization detail from the original session-parallel paper.
